purpose: Convert the strongest Waves 1-9 evidence into original Book-owned diagrams, case tables and diagnostic exercises without copying third-party figures and without changing learner-runtime content in this research PR.

artifacts.title: Black speck: observation to discriminating evidence
artifacts.content: Book-owned decision ladder separating contamination, stagnant/degraded material, hopper/feed contamination and tooling/process hypotheses. Each branch specifies the observation that would discriminate it and the intervention evidence needed before calling it root cause.
artifacts.exercise: Give learners the same initial symptom but three evidence packets; require them to choose the next measurement rather than a parameter change.
artifacts.boundary: Do not present filter-mesh, barrel cleaning or hopper contamination as universal first fixes.

artifacts.title: Black-spot interventions: what changed and what did not prove
artifacts.content: Original side-by-side table with baseline defect rate, intervention, post-intervention defect rate, confirmation method, sustainment control and evidence limitations.
artifacts.exercise: Ask learners to identify which causal claims are supported by each case and which remain unproven without shot-order traces.
artifacts.boundary: Keep plant-specific percentages attached to their original case context.

artifacts.title: Hot runner: command is not cavity state
artifacts.content: Original signal-chain diagram: controller command -> target stroke -> actual pin motion -> actuator current/force -> hot-runner restriction -> local melt pressure/flow -> cavity pressure -> cavity-specific quality. Mark which links are directly measured in current evidence and which remain acquisition gaps.
artifacts.exercise: Learners receive a valve-open command plus a weak cavity-pressure response and must choose measurements that distinguish controller, mechanical, melt-flow and cavity causes.
artifacts.boundary: Never infer actual pin movement solely from a command signal.

artifacts.title: Distributed melt control: measured quality outcomes
artifacts.content: Original table showing measured outcome type, actuator concept, reported change and limitation. Group all four rows under one Kazmer-family banner rather than presenting them as four independent replications.
artifacts.exercise: Ask learners why a closed-loop actuator can perform worse than a passive/self-regulating scheme when actuator response is slow.
artifacts.boundary: Reported Cp, weight variation and clamp/cycle changes are case-specific.

artifacts.title: Cooling restriction: diagnose, restore, verify
artifacts.content: Original four-stage diagram: hydraulic/thermal symptom -> localization -> cleaning/restoration -> post-maintenance verification. Include source-backed examples of flow recovery, pressure-loss change, cycle-time change and deformation/void observations.
artifacts.exercise: Provide 16 cooling-zone readings including five zero-flow zones and >1 mm deformation; ask learners to design a verification sequence before changing process settings.
artifacts.boundary: Commercial case values are examples, not universal flow or pressure-drop thresholds.

artifacts.title: Eight-cavity cooling balance after cleaning
artifacts.content: Book-owned worksheet using normalized cavity/zone flow and pressure-loss values before and after cleaning. Learners must separate total-flow improvement from residual imbalance.
artifacts.exercise: Rank next checks when total flow improves but one cavity remains thermally different.
artifacts.boundary: Normalize values where necessary rather than reproducing proprietary diagrams.

artifacts.title: Mould lifecycle: run-in, production, degradation and intervention
artifacts.content: Original state diagram combining natural lifecycle states, shot-count exposure and maintenance events. Show the difference between statistical state classification, survival/maintenance prediction and physical wear evidence.
artifacts.exercise: Give a trend of part metrology plus maintenance events and ask learners which additional physical inspection would be required before declaring tool wear as root cause.
artifacts.boundary: Model state labels and prediction accuracy do not equal measured component wear.

artifacts.title: Minimum mould maintenance record for future diagnosis
artifacts.content: Book-owned record template linking stable mould ID, shot count, component, symptom, measured condition, intervention, post-condition and part-quality verification.
artifacts.exercise: Learners repair an intentionally poor maintenance log by adding the missing fields required for future evidence-based diagnosis.
artifacts.boundary: Maintenance duration from historical cases is context, not a planning allowance.

artifacts.title: Cleaning recovery is a trajectory, not an after photo
artifacts.content: Original conceptual plot of cycle number versus residual visual contamination/colour signal, distinguishing combined-system and separately cleaned hot-runner recovery. Use only source-reported aggregate milestones and independently drawn curves unless raw data rights are obtained.
artifacts.exercise: Ask learners to define an evidence-based stop criterion and explain why a single clean-looking part is insufficient.
artifacts.boundary: Colour-change recovery is an analogue for chronology, not proof of black-speck behavior.

artifacts.title: Pressure depends on where you measure it
artifacts.content: Original moulding-system pressure map showing machine/nozzle, manifold/branch, gate-near and cavity locations, with arrows for pressure loss and timing differences.
artifacts.exercise: Learners diagnose why machine pressure rises while one cavity remains under-packed.
artifacts.boundary: Do not compare absolute pressure values across sensor locations without geometry and calibration context.

artifacts.title: Warpage: competing mechanisms and evidence
artifacts.content: Original cause/evidence map separating thermal imbalance, pressure/packing history, morphology/shrinkage and fibre-orientation pathways.
artifacts.exercise: Give two parts with similar final warpage but different cavity-pressure and cooling-zone evidence; require different next tests.
artifacts.boundary: Avoid single-cause 'turn up X' troubleshooting rules.

artifacts.title: Process window: a region supported by multiple outcomes
artifacts.content: Original evidence grid showing acceptable/rejected regions by multiple responses rather than one nominal setting. Include interactions and trade-offs rather than a single optimum point.
artifacts.exercise: Learners select a robust operating region under a changed quality priority and explain the trade-off.
artifacts.boundary: Study regions illustrate method; they are not transferable machine recipes.
